title: have sth done / it is said
recall: have something done nima uchun ishlatiladi? It is said that va He is said to farqini ayt.
formula: have / get + narsa + V3: ishni boshqa odamga qildirish — I had my hair cut
noxush hodisa ham: I had my phone stolen
It is said / believed / thought that + gap; He is said to be / to have done (o'tmish)

pairs.a: It is said that he is rich.
pairs.b: He is said to be rich.

en: I had my hair cut.
I got my hair cut.
I need to have my car repaired.
I need to get my car repaired.
I have to have my car repaired.
I had my phone stolen.
I've had my phone stolen.
We're having our house painted.
We are getting our house painted.
When did you have your computer fixed?
When did you get your computer repaired?
I need to have my eyes tested.
I should get my eyes checked.
It is said that he is very rich.
He is said to be very rich.

items.uz: U eng yaxshi o'yinchi deb hisoblanadi.
en: He is considered the best player.
He is considered to be the best player.
She is said to be 100 years old.
It is said that she is 100 years old.

items.uz: O'g'ri Toshkentga qochib ketgan deb taxmin qilinmoqda.
en: The thief is believed to have escaped to Tashkent.
It is believed that the thief escaped to Tashkent.
It is believed that the thief has escaped to Tashkent.
I had my suit cleaned.
I got my suit cleaned.
He had a new kitchen built.
He had a new kitchen built in his house.

items.uz: Aytishlaricha, bu yerda qadimda shahar bo'lgan.
en: It is said that there was a city here in ancient times.
There is said to have been a city here long ago.
I had a tooth pulled out.
I had my tooth taken out.
I had a tooth removed.
Prices are expected to rise.
It is expected that prices will rise.
You need to have your passport renewed.
You should get your passport renewed.

items.uz: Ular eng yaxshi restoran deb tan olingan.
en: It is known as the best restaurant.
It is recognised as the best restaurant.
It is considered the best restaurant.
I have my hair cut every month.
I get my hair cut every month.

items.uz: U dunyodagi eng tez odam deb ishoniladi.
en: He is believed to be the fastest man in the world.
It is believed that he is the fastest man in the world.
We had the window replaced.
We got the window replaced.

speak: Oxirgi oyda nimalarni qildirdingiz? (have sth done) — 5 ta gap.
Shahringiz yoki mashhur odam haqida 3 ta 'It is said / He is said to'.
